scenario: LCON.2.2.1 byte-for-byte replay — recording a session and replaying its inputs into a fresh engine reproduces the output stream identically (LFST.9 strict mode). A rule that logs on each Trigger is driven across three clock ticks; the recorded stream (ticks, rule fires, logs) must match the replayed stream event-for-event after fact-handle pointers are normalized.
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule trig:
    Trigger
->
    log info "hit"
